stats.text:
You gain the ability to heal yourself. As a {ref:glossary/bonus-action}, you can roll your Martial Arts die. You regain a number of {ref:glossary/hit-points} equal to the number rolled plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1 Hit Point regained).

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {ref:glossary/long-rest}.
